variables.name: AUTHORIZED_HTTP_PORTS
variables.description: Space-separated listen ports accepted for HTTP and HTTPS.

variables.name: TIMEOUT_SOFT_MAX
variables.description: Maximum keepalive_timeout, send_timeout, client_header_timeout, and client_body_timeout in seconds. Remediation writes 5 unless this ceiling is lower.

variables.name: DH_MIN_BITS
variables.description: Minimum ssl_dhparam size in bits. Remediation generates a parameter of this size.

variables.name: HSTS_MIN_AGE
variables.description: Minimum Strict-Transport-Security max-age in seconds. Remediation writes this value.

variables.name: HEADER_BUF_MAX_BYTES
variables.description: Maximum large_client_header_buffers size in bytes. The check fails above this.

variables.name: OTHER_PERM
variables.description: find -perm mask for config directories and files. Other permission bits in this mask fail the check.

variables.name: PID_MODES
variables.description: Comma-separated modes accepted for the nginx PID file.

variables.name: ERROR_LOG_LEVELS
variables.description: Comma-separated error_log levels the check accepts. Remediation writes the first value.

variables.name: LOGROTATE_PERIODS
variables.description: Comma-separated logrotate periods the check accepts. Remediation writes the first value.

variables.name: LOGROTATE_MIN
variables.description: Minimum logrotate rotate count. Remediation writes 14 unless this minimum is higher.

variables.name: KEY_MODES
variables.description: Comma-separated modes accepted for ssl_certificate_key. Remediation applies the first value.

variables.name: FORBIDDEN_METHODS
variables.description: Comma-separated HTTP methods that must not appear in limit_except.

variables.name: BODY_SIZE_UNLIMITED
variables.description: client_max_body_size in bytes that means the limit is disabled. The check fails when the configured size equals this.

variables.name: X_FRAME_OPTIONS
variables.description: Comma-separated X-Frame-Options values the check accepts. Remediation writes the first value.

variables.name: X_CONTENT_TYPE_OPTIONS
variables.description: X-Content-Type-Options value the check requires. Remediation writes this value.

variables.name: REFERRER_POLICY
variables.description: Regular expression the Referrer-Policy value must match.
